meta.hypothesis: H-C07-3: every commutative mex operation has 0 as an absorbing element or an identity, and its diagonal f(n,n) is a known OEIS sequence.
meta.methodology: For each distinct commutative operation (first spec of each group, as in EXP-C07-01): absorbing/identity checks on [0,96)^2, growth of f(n,n) and max f(a,b) for a,b < n, OEIS novelty checks of the diagonal and of rows 1-3 (first 40 terms).
meta.question: Do the non-associative commutative mex operations have recognisable structure (identity elements, absorbing elements, linear growth, known sequences)?
meta.title: Commutative mex operations: identities, zeros, value growth and OEIS status of their sequences
